I can’t keep running in the background or proactively message you later — I don’t have the ability to perform tasks while you’re away or push notifications to you. I may be misunderstanding what you want, so please clarify: do you mean (a) you want me to work on a specific task now and deliver results in a few hours, or (b) you want an automated reminder/notification sent to you after a few hours?

Options I can do right away (pick one and give details):
- I can do the work now and deliver results in this session. Tell me exactly what “this” is and any constraints; I’ll complete it here and you can check back later.
- I can produce a detailed plan, deliverables, and timeline you can review later (you’ll need to return to read it).
- I can give step-by-step instructions or a ready-to-use automation (calendar event, scheduled email, phone reminder, Zapier/IFTTT recipe, Slack/Discord bot message, Apple Shortcut, Tasker profile, or a cron/script) so you get a message after a few hours automatically.

Quick examples (tell me which platform you use and I’ll tailor the exact steps):
- Google Calendar: create an event at the target time and add a popup/email notification (I can draft the event text for you).
- Gmail: use “Schedule send” to send an email to yourself later (I can draft the email).
- iPhone: create a Reminder or a Shortcut automation to send you a message at a set time (I can give exact Shortcut steps).
